name: Juggernaut of Khorne

bonuses.name: Mount
bonuses.text: A Juggernaut may be ridden by a Bloodletter or mortal champion of Khorne. Both take their Turn together, using the Juggernaut's movement, and each have their own Action. Rider and Mount may be targeted separately.

bonuses.name: Furious Charge
bonuses.text: When this Threat makes a Charge action, it and its rider gain +3 bonus dice to their first melee attack, and +1 to all subsequent attacks until the enemy is defeated or moves out of Engagement.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone who sees a Juggernaut must make a DN 3 Fear Test. This becomes DN 5 if they are Charged by the Juggernaut.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
